target: fixed-package preview, English EN view, no composition
setup: Before every independent subcase clear preview output, remove selection and confirm Shift highlight is off; finger only.

keys.label: Left Shift
keys.baseCase: Tap left Shift, then a, then a; expected Aa
keys.shiftCase: Tap left Shift twice, then a; expected a (second Shift cancels)
keys.actual: 按该组步骤反馈正常，未另行转录

keys.label: Right Shift
keys.baseCase: Tap right Shift, then a, then a; expected Aa
keys.shiftCase: Tap right Shift twice, then a; expected a (second Shift cancels)
keys.actual: 按该组步骤反馈正常，未另行转录

keys.label: Backspace
keys.baseCase: Type ab then Backspace; expected a
keys.shiftCase: Type ab then Shift and Backspace; expected a
keys.actual: 按该组步骤反馈正常，未另行转录

note: Empty alternate Shift action uses existing base-action fallback; modifier keys are checked by latch-on/latch-off behavior, not printable output from the modifier itself.
